base_member_text: [L15-L19] (MED/dependency-flags) The USENETCDF branch uses NETCDF_CFLAGS for Fortran compilation and separately appends -lnetcdff to global LIBS, while the nearby comment explicitly questions NETCDF_FCFLAGS/FFLAGS; Fortran include/link flags and library ownership are therefore an unclear configure contract.
audit_member_text: [L17-L19] (MED/dependency-linking) The executable omits NETCDF_FORTRAN_CFLAGS and NETCDF_FORTRAN_LIBS and instead hardcodes -lnetcdff, diverging from the library's discovered Fortran dependency settings.

base_member_text: [L28-L31] (LOW/dependency-generation) The dependency rule regenerates $(deps) from $(xbeach_SOURCES) but the included dependency file is not listed as a generated/clean target, so stale or missing dependency metadata can affect incremental builds without an explicit lifecycle.

audit_member_text: [L25-L31] (MED/dependency-generation-contract) The dependency recipe redirects into $(deps) without any local definition or guard, so an unset deps produces an invalid command and no module-order protection.
